decisions.note: Emory Wheel (school newspaper) reporting on Emory's official Class of 2029 ED2 cycle: 336 ED2 admits total; ECAS specifically 235 admits at 10% admit rate, Oxford 153 admits at 11% rate (52 overlap). Using Emory College of Arts and Sciences (ECAS) rate 10% as the canonical Emory University ED2 rate since ECAS is the primary undergraduate college. Cross-confirmed by College Kickstart (collegekickstart.com/blog/item/emory-admits-336-early-decision-ii-applicants-to-class-of-2029).

The Scarlet & Black (Grinnell's school newspaper) reporting on Class of 2029 cycle: 386 ED II applications received; ED II admit rate 18%. Newspaper confirms ED II separately from ED I. ~70 admits implied.

Northeastern ED II reported as 20% (600 admits / 6,000 applicants) by Empowerly and 7edu, but cycle attribution is ambiguous — same numbers appear in older Class of 2028 reporting. Northeastern has not officially released ED II Class of 2029 numbers (NU has delayed 2025-26 CDS per Huntington News). REFER to human verifier — likely 20% but cycle year uncertain.

_summary.notes: Of the 26 ED2 targets requested, only Emory (ECAS 10%) and Grinnell (18%) have published ED2-specific admit data for Class of 2029, both via school newspapers. JHU published 242 ED2 admits but no denominator. Williams has no ED II program at all (single ED round). All other targets do not publicly separate ED I from ED II for Class of 2029. Carleton, Hamilton, Vassar, Davidson, Bates, Colby, Smith, Washington and Lee, Haverford, Colgate, NYU, Tufts, WUStL, BU, Pomona, Middlebury, Bowdoin, Swarthmore, Vanderbilt, Wellesley, Claremont McKenna — all combine ED rounds or do not publish. The original target hypothesis (T20 LACs publish ED2 separately) did NOT hold for Class of 2029 cycle — most LACs combined ED I+II in announcements.
